context: A doctor and reporter discuss epidemiology
purpose: Teach: 親善/発祥/庁舎/受動/刑罰/緊迫/牽引/症例

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、国際親善のプロジェクト、医療界でも盛んです。
lines.en: Ren, international-goodwill projects are thriving in medicine as well.
lines.style: Measured and clear, offering information as equals. Steady eye contact. No rush. The tone of someone who has seen enough to know what matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 発祥地での先進治療、研究進んでますね。
lines.en: The advanced treatments at the source — research is really moving forward there.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity breaking through slight hesitation. Soft emphasis on 「進んでます」 like he's thinking out loud. Leaning in slightly, engaged.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。県庁舎での会議、現場と直結します。
lines.en: Yes. The prefectural meetings — they connect directly to the work on the ground.
lines.style: Unhurried confirmation. Slight nod in the voice. Patient with his thinking, not explaining down. A door opening wider.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 受動的な治療から、能動的予防に切り替えていますね。
lines.en: So it's shifting from passive treatment to active prevention.
lines.style: Reflective restatement, checking his own understanding aloud. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Not quite a question, but open — inviting her to confirm or expand.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療刑罰の国際比較、倫理面でも論じられます。
lines.en: Right. International comparisons of medical ethics — they're being discussed and debated.
lines.style: Steady delivery of fact, but with quiet weight. Clear-eyed about the complexity. No simplification. The honesty of someone used to difficult conversations.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 緊迫した感染症対応、医療界が牽引するんですね。
lines.en: So urgent infectious-disease response — medicine is really leading that charge.
lines.style: Slight wonder underneath, recognising the weight of what he's naming. Careful articulation. The note of someone beginning to understand the scope of it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。難症例にも、地道に取り組みます。
lines.en: Yes. Even the difficult cases — we work through them steadily.
lines.style: Quiet closing note of conviction. Slight fatigue underneath, but not despair. The voice of someone whose shoulders carry the work but whose resolve doesn't bend. Trailing softly into presence.
